entities.name: Ferenc Forgách, Bishop of Várad
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Baron Ferenc Forgách de Ghymes et Gács was a Hungarian prelate of the Roman Catholic Church, who served as bishop of Várad and Chancellor of Transylvania between 1571 and 1575. His mentor was Nicolaus Olahus.
